near_misses.title: Colourful sunset likely today 4:42pm
near_misses.body: 29% odds of colour. Best bets: Lewis & Clark State Recreation Site (Broughton's Bluff), Troutdale Sandy River Bridge (1914 truss) from Glenn Otto Park, Edgefield (historic Multnomah County Poor Farm), Troutdale. Horizon toward the sun is 83% open.
why: 29% chance of a colourful sunset sky (HRRR: mid/high cloud 20–80%, low cloud under 40%)
also checks for a low cloud deck between you and the sun
path toward the setting sun 83% open (25–300 km)
